newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume jumps.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume jumps.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange jumped to 1,246 kilos on Tuesday from Monday's 676 kilos as prices fluctuated through the day, dealers said.
Gold closed slightly easier in dollar terms at $343.90 an ounce, compared to $344.65 on Monday, but was unchanged in lira terms at 1,574,000 lira. It followed the European markets.
"The exchange is still largely quiet. Gold's dollar price moving between $343.90 and $345 led traders to take up positions," one dealer said.
Lira prices fluctuated between 1,573,500 and 1,577,000 per gram in the day.
The Turkish lira fell to 142,030 to the dollar from Monday's 141,720 close, steadying the gold price in lira terms at the close.
Of the day's trade -- 756 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 75.9 percent of trade in lira terms.
